page.layout: One page: two parallel columns, left column of italic Germanic words, right column of Latin glosses; running head above; signature at the foot right.
page.notes: The left column is set in italic, the right column in roman. Long s is written as plain s throughout, including in the Germanic words. The end-of-line hyphen in "nomina-ris" is printed and was read as a hyphen; the final mark after "ris" is doubtful and may be a question mark. The foot signature was read as "Q 2" and is doubtful. The left edge of the scan is torn and some letters of the left column (e.g. "Love", "Vodres") are faint.
